text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of summer
camp—a
training camp where many
Umamusume come
together to hone
their skills.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's the perfect chance to train Air
Groove for the
upcoming Shuka Sho.
Naturally, my motivation is
at an all-time
high, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You there—halt! We haven't done roll
call yet, so
don't go wandering off!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Honestly... Why do none of you seem to realize that we are not here for fun and games?!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: Looks like she's got a lot on her plate...

text_block_list.text:
Even at summer camp, the student
council takes a
leading role. With
students getting carried away
in the
beach setting, we end up even busier
than
usual.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
But you can rest easy. I have no
intention of
cutting into our valuable
training time.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: Yeah, gotta make the most of our time here!

text_block_list.text:
It's the ideal opportunity to prepare for
the Shuka
Sho, so we must—
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Hey! You there! Who said you could go
into the
bunks? What class are you in?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув seems to have her hands full
from day
one, but our summer camp is
finally here!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
